auth: Authorization: Bearer existing approved-device token; never in URL/logs
redirects: client must reject every redirect before forwarding Authorization

scope.source: existing devices.system_id joined to active systems.id

body_keys: explicit_replacements(optional list of exact record keys)
merge.records: mapping wifi:<exactUTF8SSID> -> exactly {ssid,psk,security,origin,revision,updated}; no trim/casefold/normalization; AP entries rejected
merge.revisions: server CAS counter increments independently; incoming record revision retained in provenance only; never use untrusted revision to set server counter
merge.existing_different_psk: requires current expected_revision AND (explicit_replacements containing key OR fresh active_station_server_reachable/client_reported_connected evidence)
merge.verification_semantics: reported by approved client, not independently measured by server; NM saved timestamp never proves PSK; do not label unverified candidates verified
merge.idempotent: same credentials do not alter revision, except upgrade from unverified to fresh client-reported connection

conflict.client_action: fetch latest; no silent overwrite; fresh proof or explicit user choice

client_ram_only.existing_peer_gossip: unchanged; do not blindly compare central CAS counter to existing peer revision; caller integration must preserve explicit central choice separately

captures.activation: separate reviewed change to explicit enable_captures=True
captures.ack: durable=true plus exactsequence/SHA/size; idempotent same chunk, conflicts reject
captures.quota: 507, never auto-delete captures; partial sessions not claimed committed

https_forwarding_evidence: existing Dockerfile enables proxy-headers and forwarded-allow-ips=*; Nginx overwrites X-Forwarded-Proto=https. Admin must retain backend isolation/no external8000 publication; no new direct HTTP bypass.
initialization: init-only fails if key OR catalog already exists; canonical root and UID10001:GID10002 required; no secret output
